definitions.gloss: exactly; precisely; on the dot; sharp
definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that a time, amount, or measurement is exact with no deviation. Conveys a sense of precision and punctuality.

examples.japanese: きっかり3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧きっかり1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting ended in exactly one hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧きっかり⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}した→感心する：21451_kanshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was impressed that he showed up precisely at the promised time.

notes:
An adverb emphasizing exactness, most commonly used with times and quantities. Has a slightly more emphatic, crisp feel than ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- きっかり〜⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: at exactly ~ o'clock
- きっかり〜⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧: exactly ~ minutes
- きっかり〜⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: exactly ~ yen

USAGE:
Conveys a sense of precision and sometimes impressiveness at the exactness. Often used when the precision itself is noteworthy or deliberate.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: just, exactly — the most common and neutral equivalent
- ⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧: exactly, perfectly — emphasizes a snug or perfect fit
- ⟦きっちり→きっちり：10310_kicchiri⟧: precisely, strictly — similar to きっかり but can also mean thoroughly or meticulously
